newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Wise Men see 1996 c/a surplus 13.8 bln DKK.
newsitem.headline: Danish Wise Men see 1996 c/a surplus 13.8 bln DKK.

text.p: The independent Danish Economic Council said in its biannual report on Wednesday that it expected a 13.8 billion crown current account surplus in 1996, falling to 6.3 billion in 1997.

In its previous report last May, the council, known as the Wise Men, predicted a 9.6 billion crown current account surplus in 1996 and a 10.9 billion surplus in 1997. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33 969650
